item.title: CNR 2013 dia 1
item.author: emecas
item.description:
CNR 2013, day 1 (Thursday 21 March 2013)
My notes from the first day of CNR 2013, the Congreso Nacional de Ramas: the yearly congress of the IEEE Student Branches of Spain, held from 21 to 23 March 2013 at the Escola Tècnica Superior d’Enginyeria of the Universitat de València (ETSE-UV) and organized by its IEEE Student Branch. Three topics on day 1: a neutrino telescope under the sea (ANTARES), wireless sensor networks, and an augmented mirror from IRTIC. Notes for days 2 and 3 were never written.
